header.name: ProductStrategyProcess
header.description:
This table is a collection of attributes needed for the Product Strategy Process
Unique indeces: productID, strategyID and, order
Links out to: product strategy process BOM, inventory, productopn operator workcenter, co product, approved workcenter, approved supplier and, work order process

modelDefinition.name: ProductStrategyProcess

fields.name: id
fields.description: The primary unique ID of the record.  Every model should have an id field.

fields.name: code
fields.description: concatenated field human-readable  Label Field (REQUIRED)

fields.name: standardPositions
fields.description: DEPRECATED The default number of workcenter positions to use for the productStrategyProcess. (REQUIRED, DEFAULT=1)

fields.name: standardWorkcenters
fields.description: The default number of workcenters on which to run this productStrategyProcess (REQUIRED, DEFAULT=1)

fields.name: cycleTime
fields.description: Cycle time is measured in Seconds per Inventory Unit

fields.name: distributionPercentage
fields.description:
The percentage of the Work Order Qty to be allocated to the primary workcenter. Total of all alternates and primary workcenters should not exceed 100%. 

(REQUIRED, Default 1 (100% for primary workcenter))

fields.name: idealRate
fields.description: The Ideal Rate is used for indicating 100% run time, 100% quality what you would expect the workcenter to produce. This rate is used in OEE calculations. This is always Inventory Unit Per Hour of production.

fields.name: leadTime
fields.description: Supplier lead time

fields.name: minimumProductionRunTime
fields.description: In hours the minimum amount of time a production run can be scheduled for.  (Ex: 8-hour job with 2-hour min will get up to 4 schedules with setup time per each if there is availability on a calendar)

fields.name: percentToStart
fields.description: Required percent (of total quantity) until successor process can start (or in case of auto will start). For use with  startToStart =true dependency types.

fields.name: productionOffalAllowed
fields.description:
Offal Allowance indicates the variance allowed when the workcenter is in a production mode - for scrap / offal production. The variance can be a % of the Work Order Qty, Fixed Qty or Fixed Qty/Work Order Qty. This will be considered in the Work Order Completion algorithm.
Global: Set on Process
Product/Workcenter Specific: Set on Strategy Process
Workcenter Specific: Set on Workcenter
(REQUIRED, DEFAULT = 0)

fields.name: productionOperators
fields.description: The number of operators required to use the work center for production.

fields.name: quantityToStart
fields.description: Required quantity (in productStrategy.consumtionUnit) until successor process can start (or in case of auto will start). For use with  startToStart =true dependency types.

fields.name: quotedRate
fields.description: The Quoted Rate represents the target value that you may have used for estimating or quoting this project to your customer. This can be used to evaluate how close you are between your target and actual production. This is always Inventory Unit Per Hour of production.

fields.name: setupOffalAllowed
fields.description:
Offal Allowance indicates the variance allowed when the workcenter is in a setup mode - for scrap / offal production. The variance can be a % of the Work Order Qty, Fixed Qty or Fixed Qty/Work Order Qty. This will be considered in the Work Order Completion algorithm.
Global: Set on Process
Product Specific: Set on Strategy Process
Workcenter Specific: Set on Workcenter
Process-Workcenter Specific: Set on approved workcenter

(REQUIRED, DEFAULT = 0)

fields.name: setupOperators
fields.description: The number of operators required to setup the work center for this product.

fields.name: setupRate
fields.description: The amount of time setup takes.  This is always in terms of "Hours" .

fields.name: standardRate
fields.description: The standard rate represents the typically expected production rate at this workcenter. Taking into account typical downtime, material shortages, etc. This rate is used for planning purposes, but not used for OEE calculations. This is always Inventory Unit Per Hour of production.

fields.name: timeToStart
fields.description: Required time in seconds until successor process can start (or in case of auto will start). For use with  startToStart =true dependency types.

fields.name: unitPerCycle
fields.description: Quantity produced per cycle

fields.name: unitWeight
fields.description: Weight per unit (DEFAULT = 0)

fields.name: active
fields.description: System flag indicates whether the product strategy process is active (REQUIRED, DEFAULT = TRUE)

fields.name: allowMixedLots
fields.description: Identifies mixed lots (REQUIRED, DEFAULT = FALSE)

fields.name: autoTriggerDependency
fields.description:
Automatically start/finish next/prev process.

SS - Auto start this process time/qty/percent after prev starts.

SF - Auto finish previous process after this process starts (assuming it is complete)

FS - Auto start this process after previous finishes

FF - Auto finish this process after previous finishes (assuming it is complete)

(REQUIRED, DEFAULT = FALSE)

fields.name: certification
fields.description: When marked True - any personnel expected to perform work at this process must have a valid certification on file.

fields.name: defaultDistribution
fields.description: if default distribution = True, this strategy process will create a work order distribution record upon work order creation. when false - no distribution will be created for this WC but can be added to the WO manually after the fact (REQUIRED, DEFAULT = TRUE)

fields.name: final
fields.description: Internal Use Only - Keeps track of final process of strategy

fields.name: finishedGood
fields.description: Finished Good indicates the end product (REQUIRED, DEFAULT = FALSE)

fields.name: rawMaterial
fields.description: Raw Material indicates whether the strategy process used raw material (REQUIRED, DEFAULT = FALSE)

fields.name: transferSerial
fields.description: Processes with "Transfer Serial" attribute will advance inventory from either the prior process or a BOM component with consumption type "transfer serial". Processes with "Transfer Serial" must have a predecessor or a single item in BOM whose consumption is configured as "transfer serial"

fields.name: useWorkcenterRates
fields.description: If useWorkcenterRates is set to true, the standard, setup, ideal, and quoted rates set on the workcenter will be used. (REQUIRED, DEFAULT = FALSE)

fields.name: wip
fields.description: Work in progress (REQUIRED, DEFAULT = FALSE)

fields.name: description
fields.description: description

fields.name: externalId
fields.description: Links out to other system

fields.name: order
fields.description: Order of process in Product Strategy (REQUIRED)

fields.name: customData
fields.description: A place to store multiple attributes or pieces of custom data for the ProductStrategyProcess.

fields.name: processId
fields.description: Identified the process (REQUIRED)

fields.name: process
fields.description: Process object (REQUIRED)

fields.name: productStrategyId
fields.description: Identifies the product strategy (REQUIRED)

fields.name: productStrategy
fields.description: ProductStrategy object (REQUIRED)

fields.name: documentDesignId
fields.description: Identifies the document

fields.name: documentDesign
fields.description: document object this document is the primary label to be generated for inventory when created in Fuuz.

fields.name: lotControlId
fields.description: Identifies the lot control

fields.name: lotControl
fields.description: LotControl object

fields.name: mDocumentDesign
fields.description: Pallet Label Document Design Id.

fields.name: pDocumentDesign
fields.description: Part/Product label document Id (typically non-serialized - for identification only)

fields.name: putAwayLocationId
fields.description: Default location to put away inventory produced by thie productStrategyProcess

fields.name: putAwayLocation
fields.description: PutAwayLocation object

fields.name: schedulingGroupId
fields.description: Identifies the scheduling group

fields.name: schedulingGroup
fields.description: SchedulingGroup object

fields.name: workcenterId
fields.description: Workcenter that process will be run on

fields.name: workcenter
fields.description: workCenter object

fields.name: inventory
fields.description: Link to inventory
